correctness.rationale: For the specified non-lazy walk, the two streams of uniform vertex draws are independent; fixing the first label in the starting part leaves the law of its coupon completion count unchanged by label symmetry. The alternating draw counts give all three CDF formulas including t=0. In RESULT.md lines 43–53, the Stirling recurrence differentiates z(1+z)Q_k; Rolle interlacing from Q_1=1 puts all roots of Q_k simply in (-1,0). Newton's inequalities give strict unnormalized coefficient log-concavity on the positive support, so U_n(k+1)/U_n(k)=1+A_{n-1}(k)/A_n(k) increases strictly over 1<=n<=k. The zero-support and first positive time k=a-1 are separate cases. With the same independent coupon counts on both starts, the time difference equals +1, 0, or -1 according to their ordering, giving precisely the stated mean identity and boundaries. For K_{3,2} the first gap is (2/9)(1/2)=1/9 and the mean gap is 1-3E[2^(1-X_3)]=7/10 by summing the geometric series for the 3-coupon distribution. The 'uniquely' wording is about the starting part, not a unique vertex: the minimizer set is exactly A when a>b. The supplied checker and verification notes were inspected, not executed; the analytic proof is unbounded.
